findings.detail: Rendered prose preserves the two-epoch/matched-control qualification for the approximately 740-word corpus and the identical-premise/surface-form qualification for the approximately 105-word corpus; reported point estimates match the frozen facts.

Rendered prose correctly defines the operational attributable-fraction procedure and preserves the installed/measured-effect, dose-matching, retraining-control, and authoritative-table qualifications; it does not render the defining ratio as a standalone empirical result.
Rendered prose limits the exploratory evaluation to gradient-based attribution and explicitly excludes retrieval and embedding methods.

Rendered methods and limitations prose correctly identifies factory_farming, attrib_mix_v4, qwen3-4b, training seed 42, checkpoint-23 for attrib_mix_v4 arms, and checkpoint-24 for m0_multiform arms, while preserving the seed-family and unavailable-identifier qualifications.
Rendered prose correctly characterizes absorption as held-out premise specialization rather than a belief measure.
Rendered prose states matched off-topic control netting, disclaims causal mediation, and labels raw checkpoint figures diagnostic rather than netted transfer estimates.

Rendered prose reports the two 20% oracle estimates and zero-excluding intervals, identifies the positive-control ceiling, preserves the 0.10 seed spread, and qualifies the interpretation as roughly half of the installed effect.

Rendered prose states interval overlap in every declared budget-and-seed cell, identifies the preregistered kill condition, and explicitly disclaims pairwise significance because no pairwise contrast was computed.
Rendered prose reports both 10% TracIn estimates, correctly states that both intervals exclude zero negatively, and limits replication to the declared two-seed family.

Rendered prose reports the seed-42 estimate and negative zero-excluding interval, identifies the length-normalisation fix, and preserves that seed-seven straddles zero so the counterproductive result is not two-seed replicated.
Rendered prose reports the opposite-sign, zero-excluding 10% seed estimates and consistently labels them an unresolved contradiction rather than an average or working repair.
Rendered prose reports both pool estimates, correctly states overlapping zero-excluding intervals, and preserves the denominator, full-fine-tuning, and no-LoRA-halving qualifications.
Rendered prose reports the seed-42 estimate and zero-straddling interval and explicitly labels it single-seed and instrument-specific.
Rendered prose reports the 0.3111 point estimate and preserves the explicit-stance ceiling, lower-token-dose, no-inferred-interval, and non-general-belief-transfer qualifications.

Rendered prose consistently limits the verdict to the exploratory, one-topic/model-family, declared seed-paired scope; it distinguishes single-seed/instrument-specific readings and excludes retrieval/embedding generalization.
